title: engine_state
description: <engine home>/state/active.json (default ~/.whynot-cut/state/active.json): the item the engine is working on. Written by the `reel` writer commands (T6.2b, the executor's part; nothing writes it before that), with one atomic write per command. Read by `reel serve` (serve/engine_state.py), defensively and only ever read: a missing file, one over 64 KiB, one that breaks this schema, a client_root or item that could leave the client folder, or an `at` more than 12 h old means no item. The daemon then fills PanelState (client, item, pipeline, approval, qc) from the item's own evidence files.

client_root.description: absolute path of the client folder (the folder holding assets/ and data/, lib/common.py Paths); no '..' segment

item.description: the project id: one plain folder name under <client_root>/output/projects (lib/common.py check_project_id)

stage.description: the `reel` writer command that wrote this record (e.g. plan, approve-plan, ppro-build). Informational: the pipeline strip comes from the evidence files

session_id.description: the Claude Code session the command ran in; null outside one

claude_pid.description: that session's Claude process id (the Claude pill's liveness check); null outside one

at.description: when the record was written, RFC 3339 with a time zone
